instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a modern indoor lounge with light wood paneling, a group completes a hand stack over a wooden coffee table. The man in the patterned blue polo (R2) leans far forward from the left, placing his hands in the center stack. The woman in the black top (R3) sits in the right foreground with her back to the camera, hands joined in the pile. In the center background, the man in the green t-shirt (R1) leans forward to participate, alongside the man in the red plaid shirt (R4) from the right background. Warm indoor lighting casts a soft glow over the group's collaborative gesture.
